Real anatomy and natural material proportions, hand-painted gouache and oil brushwork, broad purposeful tonal masses, matte pigment, restrained natural light, charcoal shadows, muted ochre, deep blue, olive green, cloth crimson. The image must communicate an action or a political relationship, not be a shiny collectible badge. No gold jewellery, no shiny 3D toy render, no cartoon, no vector-flat glyph, no enamel, no thick outlines, no laurel wreath, no circular metal frame, no crown or three-star decoration. Compact cutout composition with an irregular but clean silhouette and true transparent exterior, full subject visible with breathing room, approximately square 93:91 ratio, designed to read at 93x91. Supporting setting is only a few simple shapes immediately behind the focal subject, not a rectangular scene. No writing, captions, watermarks, tiny faces, decorative globe, fantastical scenery, or unrelated elements. Do not copy a specific existing poster. Subject: a naturally proportioned adult Vietnamese diplomat's RIGHT HAND in a dark navy suit sleeve, white shirt cuff, firmly lifting a modest real DARK WOODEN ASEAN chairmanship gavel vertically upward. Gavel head is small cylindrical wood, handle longer, realistic ceremonial proportions, not a giant judge mallet. The hand, upward gavel and red Vietnam flag with ONE centered YELLOW FIVE POINT STAR dominate foreground. Supporting lower background: a shallow curved council tabletop with THREE simple microphone silhouettes and a small unbranded navy panel with an abstract golden rice bundle, communicating Southeast Asian regional convening. No faces or complete people. The gesture signifies receiving responsibility and leading ASEAN 2010/2020, based on press-photo ceremonial gavel handover, not punitive justice.
